query:
SELECT s.id, s.name
FROM class_students cs
JOIN students s ON cs.studentId = s.id
WHERE cs.classId = 60001
  AND s.id NOT IN (SELECT studentId FROM session_students WHERE sessionId = 660005)
ORDER BY s.name;
